summary: Silvercorp Metals filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching its Q2 Fiscal 2027 earnings release for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Adjusted net income was $18.4 million ($0.08 per share), net income $5.3 million, revenue $72.1 million (down 13% on lower output), operating cash flow $62.7 million and free cash flow $4.7 million. Ying safety works are substantially complete and approved; cash plus investments totaled $383.7 million, and an RMB750 million (~US$112 million) loan drawdown followed quarter-end. No special-situation transaction; routine operational results disclosure.
